alignment.scheme: Department teaching order with White Rose-style representations
alignment.scope: Year 7 and Year 8 follow the supplied numbered teaching folders and 2026–27 schemes. Year 9 follows the Y9 Combined (H+F) GCSE teaching sequence. Revision resources consolidate related lessons; original White Rose-style representations are retained. Supplementary blocks sit outside the main route.

learning.format: Short swipeable slides, labelled diagrams, worked steps, word cards and practice
